ValidationRule.description: Blocks a free email address on a lead from a company of 200 or more employees.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NumberOfEmployees >= 200, OR( CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "@gmail."), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "@yahoo."), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "@hotmail."), CONTAINS(LOWER(Email), "@outlook.") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use a work email for companies of 200 or more.
